decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of both the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 10 Kevin Close.

Condition : 6 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 2001/b/11/02B shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of single storey side extension and single storey attached garage to dwellinghouse and demolition of existing detached garage.
